title: Draft Gate Waiver
description: An authorized exception to one gate condition, on one exact revision. Bound to the revision rather than the Change: an exception accepted for the work as it stood is not an exception for whatever it becomes.

reason.description: Required: an unexplained waiver cannot be reviewed, renewed or revoked on its merits.

expires_at.description: Strictly later than waived_at: a waiver that expires no later than it was granted waives nothing.
